crossRefs.note: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five…

translations.web: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
translations.bsb: and each door had two swinging panels. There were two panels for one door and two for the other.
translations.kjv: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other
translations.asv: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves: two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
